chapter: Kansas City, Basie, Prez and Booker Pittman
title: Hanging out with Prez in Kansas City
summary: Budd and Prez gather in the hotel lobby, and Prez wakes him at night to cut visiting tenor players.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Well anyway, we were all having it -- this was really living. You know? I had never lived this way

before. And so Prez and I became very good friends. We used to congregate in the lobby of the hotel every night and get high and laugh and giggle. There was no law against reefer then. Of course I don't smoke now, but this was in my younger days when I was a little bit wild, and I used to smoke, but I mean we were all together. We never caused any trouble.

Of course it was a social thing. You know. We never caused any trouble. All we wanted to do was to be together and play. Like Prez used to come by my room like and wake me up 2:00 3:00 o'clock in the morning, say "get up." I'd say "Come on, Prez, don't do that." He'd say, "Come on, man. It's -- this tenor players come in town and they're over on 12th Street, and --" he says, "We got to go over there and blow on them."
I say, "Man, I don't feel like it." He say, "Drink some of this whiskey and get up." And I'd drink, glug, glug, glug, glug, glug, get up and put on my clothes -- huh?
